name: data-table-01
title: 数据表格
description: 支持筛选、选择、编辑与虚拟滚动的数据集表格。

files.content:
import type * as React from "react"
import type {
  ColumnDef,
  SortingState,
  PaginationState,
  ColumnFiltersState,
  RowSelectionState,
} from "@tanstack/react-table"

type DataTableMeta<T> = {
  align?: "left" | "center" | "right"
  editable?: "text" | "number"
  validate?: (value: unknown, row: T) => string | undefined
  hideOnMobile?: boolean
  pinned?: boolean
  width?: number
}
type DataTableColumn<T> = ColumnDef<T, unknown> & { meta?: DataTableMeta<T> }
type DataTableLabels = {
  emptyDescription: string
  noResultsDescription: string
  errorDescription: string
  items: string
  page: string
  editDescription: (value: string, column: string) => string
  search: string
  columns: string
  reset: string
  density: string
  compact: string
  standard: string
  comfortable: string
  selected: string
  selectAll: string
  clear: string
  retry: string
  empty: string
  noResults: string
  clearFilters: string
  previous: string
  next: string
  total: string
  perPage: string
  jump: string
  cancel: string
  save: string
  saveError: string
  selectPage: string
  selectRow: string
}
type DataTableProps<T> = Omit<React.ComponentProps<"div">, "onChange"> & {
  columns: DataTableColumn<T>[]
  data: T[]
  getRowId: (row: T) => string
  mode?: "client" | "manual"
  rowCount?: number
  loading?: boolean
  error?: string | null
  onRetry?: () => void
  sorting?: SortingState
  defaultSorting?: SortingState
  onSortingChange?: (value: SortingState) => void
  pagination?: PaginationState
  defaultPagination?: PaginationState
  onPaginationChange?: (value: PaginationState) => void
  globalFilter?: string
  defaultGlobalFilter?: string
  onGlobalFilterChange?: (value: string) => void
  columnFilters?: ColumnFiltersState
  defaultColumnFilters?: ColumnFiltersState
  onColumnFiltersChange?: (value: ColumnFiltersState) => void
  rowSelection?: RowSelectionState
  defaultRowSelection?: RowSelectionState
  onRowSelectionChange?: (value: RowSelectionState) => void
  onSelectAll?: () => void
  bulkActions?: (selected: T[]) => React.ReactNode
  rowActions?: (row: T) => React.ReactNode
  onCellCommit?: (change: {
    rowId: string
    columnId: string
    value: unknown
    row: T
  }) => void | Promise<void>
  virtualization?: false | { estimateRowHeight?: number; height?: number }
  toolbar?: React.ReactNode
  statusFilter?: {
    columnId: string
    options: { value: string; label: string }[]
  }
  labels?: Partial<DataTableLabels>
}
export type { DataTableProps, DataTableColumn, DataTableMeta, DataTableLabels }

import type { DataTableLabels } from "./types"
const DATA_TABLE_LABELS: DataTableLabels = {
  emptyDescription: "添加第一份数据集，开始整理团队的数据资源。",
  noResultsDescription: "试试其他关键词，或清除筛选条件。",
  errorDescription: "暂时无法读取数据，请稍后重试。",
  items: "条",
  page: "页",
  editDescription: (value, column) => "编辑「" + value + "」的" + column,
  search: "搜索数据集…",
  columns: "列设置",
  reset: "恢复默认",
  density: "密度",
  compact: "紧凑",
  standard: "标准",
  comfortable: "舒适",
  selected: "已选",
  selectAll: "选择全部",
  clear: "清除选择",
  retry: "重试",
  empty: "暂无数据",
  noResults: "没有符合条件的结果",
  clearFilters: "清除筛选",
  previous: "上一页",
  next: "下一页",
  total: "共",
  perPage: "每页条数",
  jump: "跳至",
  cancel: "取消",
  save: "保存",
  saveError: "保存失败，请重试",
  selectPage: "选择当前页",
  selectRow: "选择行",
}
const numberFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("zh-CN")
export { DATA_TABLE_LABELS, numberFormat }
